Method of Attack: Exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities in Google Chrome and Microsoft Windows to download and install malware
Using a zero-day Google Chrome vulnerability (CVE-2019-13720) to execute malicious scripts and download malware
Using a Windows zero-day privilege elevation vulnerability (CVE-2019-1458) to gain higher privileges and escape Chrome sandbox
Attack Vector: Injected malicious JavaScript tag in a hacked Korean-language news portal
Exploit chain combining Chrome zero-day and Windows zero-day vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Injected JavaScript tag in Korean-language news site
Command and control server delivering malware payloads
